title: Lanework global config
description: The machine's own `Config/index.md` — one level up from every board, and never synced.

schema.description: Always 1, written at the seed and never bumped by this document.

kind.description: `config`. Written at the seed and backfilled on the next seeded-body upgrade; believed outright and read by nothing.

handle.description: The mention-handle override, ahead of the host username. An empty string is not an override.

due-soon.description: The due-soon horizon's global level: a board's own subkey overrides it, and both absent falls to 1.

priorities.description: Retired 2026-09-01, and not read at all since 2026-09-07. The document keeps its bytes. The one-time migration script folds it into the document's own `default-labels`, which is also retired and not read, and a board gains a `priority` kind in its `config.labels` only where that board's own cards use priority.

default-labels.description: Retired, and not read at all: a board's label vocabulary is its own `config.labels` plus the built-in `text` kind, and nothing on this machine adds to it. A document still carrying it keeps its bytes.

thumb-sizes.description: The picker's size roster at the cascade's global level; a board's own overrides it.

restore-open-boards.description: Whether the app reopens the previously open boards at launch. Absent means true.

waiting-signpost.description: Whether the app signposts the moment a card's waiting flag arrives for this machine's human. Absent means true. False turns the announcement off and leaves the flag itself showing.

templates-repo.description: The GitHub repository the New Board Gallery reads, as `https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>`. Absent, or a value that is not a readable GitHub repo URL, means laneworkapp/lanework-templates. Never a ref: the app always reads `main`.

logging.description: The board log's global default level and retention.

config.description: The machine's settings block. Absent means every subkey takes its default.
